title: Understanding Linearization
text: When trying to linearize a relationship, consider transformations that can make the data appear more linear. Think about how logarithms or square roots might affect the data.

title: Exploring Logarithmic Transformations
text: Logarithmic transformations can be useful when dealing with exponential growth or when the data spans several orders of magnitude. Consider how applying a logarithm to the x-values might help.

title: Choosing the Right Transformation
text: Which transformation would make the x-values more linear if they exhibit exponential growth?
